integrity: Analytic proof supplies the infinite-amplitude and all-parameter assertions; checker exercises only algebraic identities and finite quadratures. One-parameter boundary behavior is recognized as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive velocity-feedback coefficient; nonnegative cubic restoring coefficient; no uniformity as the feedback coefficient approaches zero; no finite-amplitude closed form or convergence rate.
title: Uniform period crossover and arcsine turning layers in a cubic global center
